episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the impact of the Federal Reserve's leadership change on mortgage rates, the benefits of DSCR loans for real estate investors, and strategies for generating investor leads through platforms like BiggerPockets. He also highlights the tax advantages of real estate investments, emphasizing the importance of depreciation and cost segregation.
